plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Biola University Catalog 2026-27, 'Computer Science, B.S. Standard Computer Science (CSST)' course sequence (the standard, non-Torrey track). Source PDF downloaded from catalog.biola.edu and text-extracted with pdftotext -layout; every row cross-checked against the PDF's printed per-term totals and the printed 'Total Credits 126'. The live catalog (https://catalog.biola.edu/, titled 'Biola University Catalog 2026-27') is the current catalog year as of 2026-09-30. Catalog degree requirements: Program Course Requirements 21 cr + Standard Computer Science concentration 41 cr + Core Curriculum 64 cr = 126, matching the sequence's own printed total (catalog header range 124-126 covers both concentrations). Course titles verified in the 2026-27 catalog course listings (BBST/ENGL/GNST/KNES/HIST/POSC entries). The B.S. does NOT use the Torrey Honors (HNRS) sequence and is NOT the Data Science and Information Systems (CSDI) concentration - those separate official sequences are not transcribed here. Core Curriculum placeholders (Communication, Literature, Science, Behavioral Science, Fine Arts, Philosophy, Foreign Language, KNES Activity) are choice slots: the sequence names the core area, not a specific course; students pick from the catalog's approved Core Curriculum list. Foreign Language: B.S. students complete 4 credits of one language unless 2+ years of high-school study in the same language waives it (Core Curriculum page). CSCI 440 Topics in Computer Science may be taken multiple times with different topics. The PDF prints 'Graduation Application due in Registrar's Office' as a third-year milestone (administrative, not a course - not included as a course row). The official sequence publishes no prerequisite column; prereq lists are therefore left empty rather than invented. All concentration/program course codes and credits are the catalog's own.
